All principal astronomical periods for a given precession constant

Source: R/orbital_periods.R
orbital_periods.Rd

All principal astronomical periods for a given precession constant

Usage

orbital_periods(
  k_yr = NULL,
  p_arcsec = NULL,
  g = NULL,
  s = NULL,
  terms = c("nine", "all"),
  data_dir = NULL
)

Arguments

k_yr

Precession constant k expressed as the period of the axial precession, in years (numeric, > 0), e.g. 20700 for the Devonian estimate of Zeeden et al. (2023); ignored when p_arcsec is given. One of k_yr and p_arcsec is required. Default=NULL.

p_arcsec

Precession constant as a frequency in arcsec/yr (numeric, > 0; about 50.5 today); if given it is used instead of k_yr. Default=NULL.

g

Secular frequencies g1-g9 of the planetary perihelia in arcsec/yr (numeric vector of length 9). NULL uses the La2004 values of La04gisi.csv. Default=NULL.

s

Secular frequencies s1-s9 of the planetary nodes in arcsec/yr (numeric vector of length 9). NULL uses the La2004 values of La04gisi.csv. Default=NULL.

terms

Which terms are returned (character): "nine" (the Acycle ORBIT9 set: g2-g5, g3-g2, g4-g2, g3-g5, g4-g5, k+s3, k+g5, k+g2, k+g4) or "all" (every gi-gj eccentricity term and every k+si and k+gi term for i = 1 to 5). Default=c("nine", "all"), i.e. "nine".

data_dir

Folder that contains the data tables AstroGeo22.txt and La04gisi.csv (character path). NULL uses getOption("cocoR.data") or the copies installed with WaverideR. Default=NULL.

Value

data.frame: term, group, frequency (arcsec/yr), period (kyr)
